title: A technique to be aware in dreams
caption:
The breath carries something invisible: prana, life energy. Feel it as you fall asleep, and you will be aware even in your dreams.

Technique 7 of 112. Only at the moment of falling asleep, feel the invisible breath at the forehead reaching the heart, and let sleep come.

Save this and try it tonight in bed.

Technique and sutra from Osho, The Book of Secrets.
